lead.purpose: One-sentence standfirst under a heading, max 56ch.

label.purpose: Button labels; small bold folha sans for specialty audiences and notes.

path-word.purpose: Milestone words set on the SVG line; 13px on mobile.

shadows.name: action-rest
shadows.purpose: Pinho action on light grounds at rest.

shadows.name: action-lift
shadows.purpose: Pinho action on hover with 2px rise.

shadows.name: action-on-pinho
shadows.purpose: Lima action on pinho grounds and in the header.

shadows.name: floating-action

shadows.name: photo-settle

shadows.name: legend-card
shadows.purpose: Pinho address card hanging over the map.

shadows.name: frame-lift
shadows.purpose: Gallery photo on hover, with a 6px rise (fine pointers).

shadows.name: signature-lift
shadows.purpose: Footer credit pills on hover, with a 2px rise.

shadows.name: cutout
shadows.purpose: filter on alpha cutouts over pinho (.3 on the close).

shadows.name: studio-canvas
shadows.value: radial-gradient(ellipse 34% 9% at var(--sx) 100%, rgba(3,16,11,.55), transparent 72%), radial-gradient(ellipse 42% 52% at var(--sx) var(--sy), rgba(120,190,150,.16), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(ellipse 130% 95% at var(--sx) 45%, transparent 52%, rgba(5,22,15,.62) 100%), var(--canvas) cover on pinho
shadows.purpose: Painted studio backdrop for portrait sections, the share image and the 404: floor shadow, light behind the sitter, vignette.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The single easing for entrances, lifts, ticks and nodes.

motion.name: heading-unveil
motion.purpose: h1, h2 and the name heading.

motion.name: photo-unclip
motion.value: clip-path inset(18% 0 0 0 round 22px) + scale 1.06 -> rest, 1.3s/1.6s ease

motion.name: tick-reach
motion.purpose: Ticks, nodes and dots when the pen passes.

motion.name: path-word-fade
motion.purpose: Words on the line appear after the pen passes.

motion.name: fab-label
motion.purpose: Floating button label slides out on hover/focus (desktop).

motion.name: line-follow
motion.value: one travelled distance poured into the segments in order; per-frame glide k = 1 - g^(dt/16.7), g longer on large screens (.895), shorter on phones (.83) and short screens (.8)
motion.purpose: The single stroke and its head.

motion.name: line-schedule
motion.value: scroll measured along the route: blend of depth and route length, sideways travel weighted .8
motion.purpose: Flat runs and loops are spread over the scroll instead of firing off or stalling.

motion.name: line-intro
motion.value: 2.2–3.6s, grows with line length, cubic ease-in-out
motion.purpose: A data-intro section (hero, /links) draws its whole line on load at a walking pace.

motion.name: line-trail
motion.value: stroke 2.2, dasharray 0 10, round caps, opacity .32 (.3 on pinho)
motion.purpose: Dotted route ahead of the head; hidden under reduced motion.

motion.name: ghost-appear
motion.value: ghost opacity ramps in after the first 60px of stroke over 140px; each echo trails 40px further back
motion.purpose: Echoes appear only once the head has a real stroke behind it.

motion.name: pinned-gallery
motion.value: stage sticky under the header; vertical scroll translates the strip; hold of min(160px, 18vh) at both ends
motion.purpose: O espaço film. Short screens: strip only, heading fades over the hold. Floating button hides while held. Off under reduced motion.

motion.name: growing-child
motion.value: limbs posed from distance travelled (no-slip stride), stage per section: sit, crawl, walk, run; stage cross-fade .35s
motion.purpose: The child at the head of the line; only the sitting stage idles in time. Absent under reduced motion.

motion.name: menu-sheet
motion.value: clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) -> inset(0), .7s ease; links stagger 50ms

motion.name: faq-slide
motion.purpose: FAQ answers slide; one open at a time.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: no js-motion; whole line drawn at once, no ghosts, no trail, no intro, no child, no pin; transitions .001ms

components.css: :host{--pinho:#123F2E;--pinho-h:#1C4D39;--folha:#286F47;--lima:#C9E46A;--lima-h:#D7EE84;--nevoa:#F1F5EF;--branco:#FBFCFA;--menta:#DDEBDD;--ink:#10241B;--muted:#4A6155;--on-pinho:#EEF4EC;--on-pinho-muted:#B7CDBE;--line:#CFDCCF;--line-dark:rgba(201,228,106,.22);--ease:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);--display:'Bricolage Grotesque',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;--sans:'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next','Atkinson Hyperlegible',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-sheet{position:relative;background:var(--pinho);color:var(--on-pinho);padding:72px 28px 32px}.ds-toggle{position:absolute;top:16px;right:20px;display:grid;place-items:center;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--line-dark);background:transparent;color:var(--on-pinho);cursor:pointer}.ds-toggle:hover{border-color:var(--lima);color:var(--lima)}.ds-toggle .bars{position:relative;display:block;width:18px;height:12px}.ds-toggle .bars i{position:absolute;left:0;top:5px;width:100%;height:2px;border-radius:2px;background:currentColor;transform:rotate(45deg)}.ds-toggle .bars i:last-child{transform:rotate(-45deg)}.ds-mlist{list-style:none;margin:0;position:relative;padding-left:34px}.ds-mlist::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:8px;top:8px;bottom:8px;width:3px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--lima)}.ds-mlist a{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:56px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--on-pinho);font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;font-variation-settings:'wdth' 92;letter-spacing:-.015em;font-size:2rem;line-height:1.1;transition:color .2s ease}.ds-mlist a:hover{color:var(--lima)}.ds-mlist a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--lima);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:8px}.ds-mlist .tick{position:absolute;left:-36px;top:50%;width:18px;height:3px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--lima);transform:translateY(-50%)}

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "O Traço do Movimento"**

Development is movement, so the site is drawn by one continuous line. It starts as a lima dot at the bottom of the hero, loops around a real cutout of Daphine, and then, section by section, the reader's scroll draws it down the page as a single stroke with a single head. It touches every place where something happens: each warning sign gets a tick, each specialty gets a tick, each of the three steps gets a lit node, each city stop gets a dot. It ends in a loop around the final WhatsApp button. At its head rides a small line-drawn child who grows up as the page goes on: sitting in the hero, crawling through the signs, walking from the first steps to Daphine's story, running from the reviews to the final button. The visual vocabulary borrows from chronophotography and movement notation. Fading ghost echoes trail the stroke the way Marey's plates trail a moving body, a dotted trail marks the route still ahead, milestone words (sentar, engatinhar, ficar em pé, andar, pular, equilibrar) sit on the path itself, and real photographs of the practitioner are cut out and locked onto the line as photomontage.

The world is green by brand commitment. The portrait sections (the hero, the close and /links) are a painted studio: a mottled pinho canvas with a soft light behind the sitter, a vignette and a floor shadow, so Daphine is photographed into the world rather than pasted onto a flat fill. The same studio carries the share image and the 404 page. A deep pinho field owns the opening, the three-step start, the families' reviews and the close. Light grounds in névoa, branco and menta rotate through the reading in between, and no two neighbouring sections share a ground. Type is a confident, slightly condensed grotesque with tight negative tracking, set against a body face built for legibility, because the reader is a worried parent on a phone. There is no warm accent. The WhatsApp action is marked by inversion instead: it is always the opposite of the ground it sits on, lima on pinho and pinho on light, so the one thing to press is the one thing that does not match its surroundings.

The density is calm: one idea per section, generous vertical rhythm, and long ruled lists instead of card grids. The system rejects the category default of the therapy and clinic website: cream grounds, italic serifs, eyebrow labels above headings, and grids of icon cards.
keyCharacteristics: One scroll-drawn line that runs from the hero to the final button as one stroke with one head, unbroken across section edges, with a dotted trail showing the route ahead.
A line-drawn child rides the head of the line and grows from sitting to running as the page goes on.
Pinho at the opening, the start, the reviews and the close, with rotating light grounds between; folha line on light grounds, lima line on pinho.
The WhatsApp action always inverts its ground (lima on pinho, pinho on light) and is never coral or any warm colour; it is the only filled button.
Portrait sections, the share image and the 404 sit on a painted, lit studio canvas instead of flat pinho.
Real alpha cutouts of Daphine set flush on a section edge or bled off the viewport.
Ruled lists, ticks, nodes, stops and hand-drawn line icons instead of cards and icon tiles.
The "O espaço" gallery pins under the header and turns vertical scroll into a sideways film.
Content enters as the line reaches it; reduced motion and no-JS show the finished drawing at once.

rules.name: The Inverted Action Rule
rules.body: The WhatsApp action always takes the opposite of its ground. On pinho grounds and in the header it is lima with pinho text and icon (hover lima-h). On light grounds it is pinho with on-pinho text and a lima icon (hover pinho-h). The floating button is pinho with a 2px lima ring and a lima icon, so it reads on both. The switch comes from the ground class, never by hand. A WhatsApp action is never coral, red or any warm colour, and no third action colour exists.

rules.name: The Two Greens Rule
rules.body: The line, its trail and the child riding it are folha on light grounds and lima on pinho, switched by the field class, never by hand. Ghost echoes are always lima, at low opacity.

rules.name: The Field Change Rule
rules.body: Adjacent sections never share a ground, so each edge the line crosses is visible. Pinho returns at four beats (the opening, the start, the reviews, the close); the light grounds névoa, branco and menta rotate in between.

rules.name: The Guest Colour Rule
rules.body: The red of the Chibo Dev stamp and the Instagram magenta live only inside the developer credit in the footer and on the 404. They are the credit's own brand marks, scoped to it, and never enter the site's palette, its actions or its line.

rules.name: The Width Axis Rule
rules.body: Headings run the wdth axis below 100: 92 for headings, 88–90 for the brand name and small display text, 80 for words on the path. Never set display text at full width.

rules.name: The Heading Starts Cold Rule
rules.body: A section opens with its heading. There is no small uppercase label, kicker or eyebrow above an h1 or h2. Uppercase tracked text exists only as footer column heads.

rules.name: The One Highlight Rule
rules.body: A heading can colour at most one word or phrase (folha on light, lima on pinho), and that word carries the meaning of the sentence ("movimento", "hoje", "curva").

rules.name: The Clear Copy Rule
rules.body: The line never crosses a heading, a paragraph, a list row's text or the WhatsApp action. It travels in the margins, through figures and around anchors. The final loop circles the button without touching it, and the button is lifted above the stroke.

rules.name: The Figure Carries the Depth Rule
rules.body: Lists, rows and sections never get shadows. If something needs to come forward, it is the person, the action, or the one card that hangs over the map.

dos: **Do** open every section with its heading, set in Bricolage Grotesque at wdth 92 with negative tracking.
**Do** make every WhatsApp action invert its ground: lima with pinho text on pinho and in the header, pinho with on-pinho text and a lima icon on light, and keep it the only filled button.
**Do** give each section a ground different from its neighbours (pinho, névoa, branco, menta), and let the field switch the line, its trail and the child between folha and lima.
**Do** match each section's `data-in` to the previous `data-out` at both sizes using the `L` / `R` lanes, and pin margin runs to a lane with `data-pt="L y"` rather than a hand-tuned fraction.
**Do** let the phone route sweep across the screen through the gaps between blocks, with mobile-only anchors, rather than parking it on one edge.
**Do** keep the child identical across stages (head, curl, forward eye, ground-filled bean torso, 2.2 stick limbs, far limbs at 0.55) and let it grow only forward through the page.
**Do** set portrait sections, the share image and the 404 on the studio canvas and place its light (`--sx`, `--sy`) behind the sitter.
**Do** add a breakpoint only for a device class that actually breaks, and change only what broke.
**Do** tie every tick, node or dot to a real item of content the reader passes.
**Do** set cutouts flush on a section edge or bleed them off the viewport, and ship each raster with its provenance sidecar.
**Do** present lists as ruled rows (1px line between rows, 2px ink rule on top) rather than boxes, with the folha line icon beside the text.
**Do** quote reviews verbatim from real, authorised sources and name where they come from.
**Do** keep the finished line visible and all content shown at once under reduced motion and without JS.
donts: **Don't** put eyebrows, kickers or small uppercase labels above headings.
**Don't** build grids of icon cards or put icons in tiles or pills; icons are folha line strokes beside text.
**Don't** make a WhatsApp action coral, red or any warm colour, or introduce a third action colour; the action is marked by inversion, not by hue.
**Don't** let the credit's red or magenta leave the developer credit.
**Don't** let the line cross a heading, a paragraph, list text or the WhatsApp action.
**Don't** give the child a face, clothes, a colour of its own or a different head from stage to stage, or let it slide without its limbs moving.
**Don't** show the cut edge of a cutout photo inside the viewport, or use generated imagery in place of real photographs of Daphine and the space.
**Don't** invent testimonials, ratings, counts or years of experience.
**Don't** add shadows to rows, lists or sections; depth belongs to the figure, the action and the map's legend card.
**Don't** fall back to the category default of cream grounds and italic serifs.
